name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes a Plex source server (added via the Companion connect-code or pasted by hand) being completely untestable and unmanageable once added - TestServer/TestAllServers already had the Plex-aware branch that routes through PlexApiClient instead of Jellyfin's own /System/Info/Public (added back in 0.0.115), but the config page's Friends roster filtered every non-Jellyfin RemoteServer out of its render entirely, so a Plex source had no card, no Test button, and no way to remove it once connected - confirmed live: a real Plex peer answered 200 on its own /identity the whole time while every Test click 404'd against the wrong endpoint, because there was nothing to click in the first place. The Friends roster now includes Plex sources alongside Jellyfin friends (marked with a Plex badge), skipping only the two sub-panels that are genuinely Jellyfin-only (per-user access rules, pools). Also added a direct 'paste an address and a token' way to connect a Plex server, for the case where there's no friend running Companion to generate a connect code. 313 tests, all green.
